task.title: Briefing Intelligence: holistic coach synthesis - real Sep 20-26 preview for Founder review (candidate d0f1ac30, not deployed)

result.summary: Synthesis redesigned around holistic goal-relative coaching: every goal-relevant domain assessed (goal policy from canonical Goal Contract evaluation), complementary insight selection with reasoned omissions, per-briefing semantic budgets (Midweek partial window, Weekly moderate, Monthly persistence, DEXA outcome-led, Photo visual-scaled), Weekly coach-voice realization with cross-section agreement. Real Sep 20-26 zero-write preview: hero pairs training progress (7 bests) with a fast weight climb (~1.7 lb/wk robust 4-week pace); DEXA/body-fat meaning; Confidence goal-level (79 hold, no exercise); routine break and unreadable Thu-Sat food logs told once; next steps: intake at or below target + training rhythm back. Confidence and recommendation unchanged.

tests.summary: 82 Briefing Intelligence tests (52 holistic properties over 5 goal types x 17 situations x 10 seeds, all briefing budgets, hand-built mismatch pictures); full repo 8998/9306 vs production baseline 8913/9221, 0 new failures (303 identical environmental).

review.summary: Five fresh-context rounds (f02b0340, c26c5f72, 95e2c9c7, 1a6b241f, d08ce692): all PASS-WITH-FIXES, last two with no High; every finding fixed, final fixes in d0f1ac30 with tests.

Canonical data still does not support reading Thu-Sat intake either way; the plan-relative intake verdict is restrained.
